fields.bachelor_requirement: Direct Undergraduate Entry: Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) or equivalent qualification with no strict fixed percentage in many cases (usually around 50–60% considered acceptable) + English requrements
fields.pathway_requirement: Foundation / Entry Route (if required): HSC pass (around 45–50%+) or equivalent qualification.+ English requrements
fields.english_requirement: Pathway- IELTS 5.5 overall (sometimes 5.0 accepted depending on course and assessment). Direct IELTS 6.0 overall (no band less than 5.5). Some programmes may also accept students based on academic profile and interview.

fields.bachelor_requirement: HSC / Higher Secondary Certificate is not automatically sufficient for direct Bachelor's entry. The Bangladeshi qualification must be recognised as equivalent to MQF/EQF Level 5 or 6, depending on the programme. For Level 5/6 entry, ITS requires a combination equivalent to minimum 3 Advanced/Intermediate-level subjects, including at least 1 Advanced-level pass, with at least 44 points under its grade-point matrix. Programme-specific requirements may also apply.
fields.pathway_requirement: MQF/EQF Level 5 qualification → Bachelor's Level 6. A Bangladeshi student can use a recognised Diploma/Higher Diploma or comparable qualification at the required EQF level. ITS can also assess a comparable foreign qualification through MQRIC.
fields.english_requirement: Bachelor's: IELTS 5.5–6.5 overall / TOEFL iBT 60–93 / CEFR B2. MOI can be considered instead of IELTS/TOEFL if the student provides evidence that their previous international degree/diploma was taught in English. ITS may additionally conduct its own English test/interview.

fields.bachelor_requirement: HSC / Higher Secondary Certificate or equivalent high-school qualification. Programme-specific academic requirements may apply. For BBA, a high-school diploma/GED/ATB or completed degree is accepted. 1 year of full-time professional experience is recommended but not stated as mandatory.
fields.pathway_requirement: Business / Management Top-Up: Relevant higher-level Diploma/Advanced Diploma or equivalent qualification may be considered, subject to recognition. A relevant post-HSC qualification such as a Diploma/Higher Diploma may also be considered with 3 years of relevant work experience, subject to RPL assessment. Accounting Top-Up: Relevant higher-level Diploma/Advanced Diploma in Accounting/Finance or equivalent may be considered. A relevant post-HSC Diploma/Higher Diploma + 3 years of relevant work experience may also be considered through RPL.
fields.english_requirement: IELTS 5.5 or PTE 59 minimum under the general requirement. Some programmes require IELTS 6.0 or equivalent.
